slides.title: What did Ethiopia and China agree on?
Defense minister met China's ambassador
slides.body: Talks in Addis Ababa, Nov 3, per Ethiopian state media.

slides.title: What both sides pledged
slides.body: More defense-industry cooperation, technology transfer and training.

slides.title: Ethiopia's position
slides.body: Defense Minister Mohamed Idris asked China to keep standing with Ethiopia.

slides.title: Dialogue, not escalation.
slides.body: Single state-media source, not independently verified. Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Ethiopian News Agency (state media) via allAfrica · Nov 3-4, 2026
